name: Lightwell Demo — Critical CVE Watch (CVSS >= 9.0)
description: Flags images containing vulnerabilities with CVSS score 9.0 or higher. Inform-only — provides visibility into critical CVE exposure.
rationale: Critical CVEs represent the highest risk to production environments. ACS monitors for their presence across all deployments.
remediation: Use Lightwell Network remediated dependencies to resolve critical vulnerabilities without upgrading to new major versions.
